number: 第二百四十八条の四の三十八
summary_ja: SA―CVA採用最終指定親会社は、内部統制、エクスポージャー計測モデルの運用、同モデルの検証、内部監査に関する要件を全て満たす。
summary_en: An Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the SA-CVA must satisfy all requirements on internal controls, operation of the exposure measurement model, its validation, and internal audit, each set out in detail.
paragraphs: An Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the SA-CVA shall satisfy all of the following requirements. (i) Requirements relating to internal controls. (ii) Requirements relating to the operation of the exposure measurement model. (iii) Requirements relating to the validation of the exposure measurement model. (iv) Requirements relating to internal audit.

The "requirements relating to internal controls" listed in item (i) of the preceding paragraph means the following requirements. (i) That a framework for risk management relating to CVA (meaning managing the CVA risk held by the Ultimate Designated Parent Company under a framework of identification, measurement, management, approval and internal reporting) has been established and is appropriately operated. (ii) That CVA and sensitivities are measured by the exposure measurement model and have been appropriately operated for at least one year before the approval. (iii) That a CVA desk satisfying all of the following requirements has been established. (a) That it is responsible for the use of the exposure measurement model and plays a leading role in formulating the risk management policy relating to CVA and in operating the risk management activities relating to CVA. (b) That traders who execute internal hedge transactions or external hedge transactions (referred to as "CVA traders" in (c)) are assigned. (c) That the roles and authority of the CVA desk and CVA traders are clearly provided, and the desk and traders are appropriately operated on the basis of those roles and authority. (d) That documents showing the status of risk management relating to CVA are prepared at a frequency of at least once a week, and the status of risk management relating to CVA and other necessary information are regularly reported to the directors, etc. (e) That the CVA balance, the profit or loss arising from changes in it, and other indicators for managing CVA are defined and incorporated into the operation of the CVA desk. (iv) That the directors, etc. are actively involved in risk management relating to CVA and devote the management resources necessary for the appropriate performance of risk management relating to CVA. (v) That a framework has been established for complying with documented internal policies, internal controls and procedures in order to appropriately operate the system for measuring the exposure of accounting CVA. (vi) That a unit that validates the exposure measurement model (referred to as the "CVA exposure model validation unit" in paragraph (5)) satisfying all of the following requirements has been established. (a) That it is responsible for conducting validation at the time of development of the exposure measurement model and periodic validation after operation begins. (b) That it is established independently of the units involved in transactions subject to the calculation of the amount of credit risk-weighted assets, the units involved in transactions subject to the calculation of the market risk equivalent amount, and the CVA desk. (c) That personnel with sufficient capability are assigned. (d) That it reports directly to the directors, etc. on the management status of the exposure measurement model.

The "requirements relating to the operation of the exposure measurement model" listed in paragraph (1), item (ii) means the following requirements. (i) That it accurately captures transaction-specific information and appropriately allocates transactions to netting sets, thereby appropriately measuring exposure on a netting set basis. (ii) That the exposure measurement model is appropriately managed in accordance with the following requirements. (a) That transaction terms are reflected in the exposure measurement model in a timely manner, and are comprehensive and conservative. (b) That a reconciliation process has been established between the exposure measurement model and the system that stores transaction terms, in order to continuously confirm that transaction terms are accurately and conservatively reflected in the exposure measurement model. (iii) That the market data used to calculate the CVA risk equivalent amount are managed in accordance with the following requirements. (a) Market data shall be obtained independently of the front office. (b) They shall be consistent with the data used in financial accounting. (c) All market data necessary for exposure measurement shall be obtained in a timely manner, and those market data shall be retained for the necessary period. (d) A framework shall be established that can appropriately identify inaccurate or anomalous market data. (e) Where the market data required by the exposure measurement model cannot be obtained and alternative market data (hereinafter in (e) referred to as "proxies") are used, appropriate proxies shall be identified in advance in documents, and it shall be shown that those proxies conservatively reflect deterioration in market conditions.

The "requirements relating to the validation of the exposure measurement model" listed in paragraph (1), item (iii) means the following requirements. (i) That rules clearly stating the processes for validation at the time of development of the exposure measurement model and for ongoing validation after operation begins have been prepared in accordance with the following requirements. (a) That the operating method, assumptions and usage limitations of the model are understandable to a third party, and the reproducibility of validation is ensured. (b) That the minimum frequency of periodic validation and the conditions for conducting additional validation (including sudden changes in the market) are provided. (c) That the validation methods for data flow (meaning the status of data input, processing and the passing of data between models; the same applies in Article 250-8, paragraph (2), item (v)) and for portfolios, and the method of constructing the Ultimate Designated Parent Company's representative CVA portfolios, are provided. (ii) That guidelines providing for the following matters have been formulated. (a) Requirements for evaluating the exposure measurement model and the inputs to that exposure measurement model (meaning the assumptions and market data used in measuring future exposure). (b) The processes for evaluating the accuracy of the exposure measurement model and for its ongoing improvement. (iii) That, in validation at the time of development of the exposure measurement model and ongoing validation after operation begins, the pricing model that calculates exposure on the basis of paths generated by simulating market risk factors is validated against independent and appropriate benchmarks corresponding to a wide range of market conditions. In this case, for pricing models of options, the non-linearity of option value with respect to market risk factors shall be taken into account. (iv) That it is confirmed that transactions are allocated to appropriate netting sets.

The "requirements relating to internal audit" listed in paragraph (1), item (iv) means that an independent audit by a department that conducts internal audits is carried out, at a frequency of at least once a year, on the entire risk management process relating to CVA (including the operation of the CVA desk and the CVA exposure model validation unit).
